module.name: Social Post
module.notes: Social Post header phase with two symmetric five-slot rows.

intent.responsibility: Own the Social Post header and its following Media section.
intent.visualBoundary: Render a Surface-backed header followed by one padded Media boundary and an optional full-width separator.
intent.runtimeBehavior: The Variant owns header structure, Media Variant, Media padding and separator visibility; Runtime owns row content plus Media source and height.
intent.forwarding: No child Runtime contract is exposed or forwarded.
intent.temporalOwnership: The Screen owns header presence while child Components retain their local behavior.
intent.productionContext: Resolve only through the exact Production Screen to Shot owner Actor to Theme and Device context.

metadata.note: Social Post defines its two-row header and one padded Media section.
